description.value: Vessel Liquor Store is an independent bottle shop on Fort Street in Victoria, BC, with a carefully curated selection spanning wine (including natural, biodynamic, and vegan-certified options), spirits, and local Vancouver Island craft beer. The store runs educational classes and a loyalty program, signalling a community-focused approach well beyond a standard convenience shop. Touring cyclists finishing a ride in Victoria can stop in for a local BC craft beer or a bottle of wine to enjoy at the end of the day.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms Vessel Liquor Store is an active retail bottle shop at 1609 Fort Street, Victoria, with a full product catalog covering wine, spirits, beer, cider, and non-alcoholic alternatives, plus online ordering with BC delivery. The website navigation explicitly lists 'Vegan' as a filterable wine subcategory under 'Farming | Winemaking', providing direct textual evidence of vegan-certified wine availability. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned in either OSM tags or the website content, and no phone number appears in either source.
